title: Nashville Skyline Duo | 10BR/BA | Rooftop Hot Tub
description:
The ultimate Nashville home base for massive groups! This rare combo listing features two designer homes side-by-side (10BR total) offering two rooftop decks, a private 7-person hot tub, and 10 full bathrooms. Located 5 minutes from Broadway and Germantown, it’s the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and "get-ready" space for bachelorettes, corporate retreats, and family reunions.
